Linux Mint

Linux Mint is a community-driven Linux distribution based on Ubuntu. It aims to be modern, elegant and comfortable to use, and ships with the Cinnamon desktop.

History

The project started in 2006. Releases follow the Ubuntu long-term support versions and are supported for five years, which makes the distribution popular with people who want a stable desktop.

Editions

Editions include Cinnamon, MATE and Xfce. Linux Mint Debian Edition (LMDE) is based on Debian instead of Ubuntu and exists to make sure the project could continue if Ubuntu disappeared.
